pages.text: A Grunt Captain is a veteran loud enough to turn nearby ogres into a coordinated problem. It fights as a tougher Grunt and calls the Tribe to attention.$(br2)Captains carry normal Grunt spoils and retain their prized Golden Ogre Tooth—the mark that makes Merchants suddenly more respectful.
Its salute is not for you. It is for everyone about to surround you.

pages.title: Hunters
pages.text: Captains never lose their nerve. They go straight at Plague Ogres and Bog Toads, and lesser Ogres that see the fight come to help.$(br2)A lone Grunt will still run from a Bog Toad. A Grunt with company will not.

pages.title: Armored Hide
pages.text: Now and then a blow glances off a Captain's armor and does no damage at all, with a spark and a ring of steel. It cannot happen twice in a few seconds, so keep swinging.
